## Code

### P2 "03-01_mandelbulb" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Mandelbulb (White / Nylander, power-n spherical formula) as a density: each voxel stores its escape iteration divided by Iterations (1 = never escaped, i.e. inside the set), so the field is stepped in 1/Iterations levels. An iso just below 1 shows the bulb. Zoom is the half-width of the sampled region (larger = more of the fractal, smaller on screen). Power drift oscillates the power over time an…; categories: 3D-GENERATOR, FRACTAL; inputs: power:float=8, zoom:float=1.3, iters:long=8, animate:float=0; resources: volume:image

28 lines, not listed: the process was created from the library file `<LIBRARY>:packages/score-csf-testers/shaderlib/volume/03-fractals/03-01_mandelbulb.cs`.

### P3 "VolumeRaymarcher" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Volumetric raymarcher for 3D textures: renders the volume (the unit cube) as a translucent cloud, coloured by its rgb, with density taken from alpha (or from rgb brightness when alpha is 1 everywhere). densityScale x absorption sets how opaque it gets, threshold hides faint density, steps trades quality for speed. Optional gradient lighting (lightDir, lightStrength, ambientLight). Orbit camera: c…; categories: Renderer, 3D, Volume; inputs: volume:image, steps:float=128, densityScale:float=10, threshold:float=0.02, absorption:float=1.5, cameraAngle:float=0, cameraPitch:float=0.3, cameraDistance:float=2.5, autoRotate:float=0.3, lightDir:point3D=[0.5,0.8,0.3], lightStrength:float=1.2, ambientLight:float=0.25, enableLighting:bool=true
